subject: Proxying, TIA sampling cadence, and subprocessor rotation for LATAM pilot
messages:
From: Felipe Sosa <felipe.sosa@bancoazul.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mariela Torres <mariela.torres@bank-ops.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: proxying question + TIA sampling cadence for LATAM pilot

Hi Mateo / Kimberly,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Two quick clarifying asks as we start the LATAM pilot scoping:

1) Proxying / onshore cache behavior: our Ops team needs to know whether Redwood will operate a regional proxy/edge in Colombia for Banco Azul traffic or whether requests will transit via EU/US nodes when customers are in-country. That will inform our in-country security controls and any export restrictions.

2) TIA sampling cadence: we understand Redwood runs TIAs/DTIAs for EU->non-EU paths. For LATAM, what sampling frequency and artifact set do you need from us (sample request logs, example user records, redacted payloads)? We want to draft an internal evidence sprint.

3) Subprocessor rotation: we've heard from procurement that your subprocessors may rotate quarterly (eg. caching or CDN providers). What notice do you provide and what evidence will be included when a rotation happens?

Attached: expected-data-map.csv (simple mapping our team produced).

Can you confirm by end of week whether the proxy will be regional and outline the TIA template you prefer?

Thanks,
Felipe
Director, Cloud Ops — Banco Azul


From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Felipe Sosa <felipe.sosa@bancoazul.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: proxying question + TIA sampling cadence for LATAM pilot

Hi Felipe — thanks, and good to confirm next steps. Quick responses inline and attached a TIA sampling template for your team.

1) Proxying / regional edge: for the pilot we can stand up an onshore edge (regional proxy) in Bogotá under the Dedicated/Partner edge program. Operationally this means inference requests from Banco Azul customers in Colombia will terminate at the Bogotá edge and not routeto EU/US for generation. We will need a short runbook from your infra team for egress firewall rules.

2) TIA sampling cadence: attached is the TIA-sampling-template.xlsx — we ask for:
  - 20 representative, redacted payloads (rows) covering high/low token lengths
  - 2 weeks of request logs (anonymized) for traffic patterning
  - a single schema file for PII markers you use
Suggested cadence: initial sample during onboarding, then quarterly sampling for 12 months, moving to semi-annual thereafter for stable traffic. If you have retention constraints we can adapt cadence.

3) Subprocessor rotation: high-level: Redwood gives 30 days' notice for non-critical subprocessor changes and 60 days for changes that affect routing or data residency (eg. moving from one CDN provider to another that changes egress location). Rotation packets include a brief evidence set (subprocessor name, controls summary, SOC2 if available, and a smoke-test checklist). If Banco Azul requires escrowed evidence we can include escrow artifacts on request (this adds a week to handoff).

I attached the TIA template and included a short checklist. Kimberly and Rishi — tagging you for legal/controls items below.

Next step: Felipe, if you can drop the 20 redacted examples into the template by next Wednesday (2025-10-15) we'll schedule a ops handoff call.

Attachment: TIA-sampling-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Mateo
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference


From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Felipe Sosa <felipe.sosa@bancoazul.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: proxying question + TIA sampling cadence for LATAM pilot

Hi all — adding the legal/controls perspective. A few notes to align expectations so procurement and our legal teams are synchronized:

- SCCs vs UK IDTA/UK Addendum: for Colombian-resident data SCCs are the baseline transfer mechanism where applicable; the UK Addendum / IDTA paths only apply if Banco Azul processes UK personal data or has UK entities. If you have a UK legal entity that will sign the DPA with the IDTA, flag it and we will route the contract to the UK addendum flow (DocuSign link below).

- Evidence set for subprocessor rotation: we provide the following when subprocessors rotate: change notice, a controls summary (one-page), updated subprocessor CSV, and if the change impacts routing we also surface a TIA mini-package (sample logs and routing proof). The standard notice period is 30 days; if Banco Azul requires a longer notice we can negotiate into the DPA.

- Audit window & retention for TIAs: Redwood retains the TIA artifacts in an encrypted evidence bucket for 12 months by default. We can extend retention (enterprise add-on) or provide time-limited access links to evidence for auditors.

DocuSign for DPA addendum: https://www.docusign.net/Contract/SigningLink?d=UKADD123
Attached: subprocessors-rotation-csv.csv (current subprocessor inventory export).

If Felipe/Mariela confirm they do not have UK processing in scope, we can proceed with SCC-based attachments and the regional edge plan. Otherwise we will queue the UK addendum signing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security — Redwood Inference


From: Felipe Sosa <felipe.sosa@bancoazul.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mariela Torres <mariela.torres@bank-ops.com>, external-legal@bancoazul.com
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: proxying question + TIA sampling cadence for LATAM pilot

Thanks — this is helpful and clear. A couple quick confirmations: 

- Banco Azul does not process UK personal data for this product stream, so SCCs are sufficient and the UK Addendum is not in scope for now.
- We'll populate Mateo's TIA template with 20 redacted payload rows and a two-week log extract by 2025-10-15.
- Procurement is ok with the 30-day rotation notice, but they requested the rotation CSV and SOC2 summary be sent to external-legal@bancoazul.com when a change is posted.

Let's put a 30-minute handoff call on the calendar the week of Oct 13 to walk through firewall rules and the evidence upload process. I'll update the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/records/PROB12345

Thanks again — Felipe
Director, Cloud Ops — Banco Azul
